group_conflict.zh-CN: 分组操作与当前状态冲突。
group_conflict.en-US: The group operation conflicts with the current state.

audit_permission_required.zh-CN: 需要会话清除审计权限。
audit_permission_required.en-US: Session purge audit permission is required.

authorization_changed.zh-CN: 设备授权正在变化，请重新提交。
authorization_changed.en-US: Device authorization is changing. Please submit again.

authorization_pending.en-US: Waiting for the user to approve authorization.

authorization_state_unavailable.zh-CN: 授权状态暂不可用，请稍后重试。
authorization_state_unavailable.en-US: Authorization state is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

baizhiyun_identity_required.zh-CN: 请通过百智云登录后使用系统资源。
baizhiyun_identity_required.en-US: Sign in through Baizhiyun to use system resources in this billing mode.

cannot_disable_self.zh-CN: 不能停用自己或移除自己的管理员角色。
cannot_disable_self.en-US: You cannot disable yourself or remove your own administrator role.

capabilities_unavailable.en-US: The capability policy is temporarily unavailable.

clock_sync_unavailable.en-US: The clock synchronization reference is unavailable.

connection_expired.zh-CN: 连接授权已过期或撤销。
connection_expired.en-US: Connection authorization has expired or been revoked.

consent_required.zh-CN: 客户端授权需要用户明确批准。
consent_required.en-US: The user must explicitly approve client authorization.

device_connection_limit.en-US: The device connection limit has been reached.

device_draining.en-US: The execution service is shutting down.

device_identity_required.en-US: Verify this device's identity before continuing.

device_offline.en-US: The target execution device is offline.

device_process_conflict.zh-CN: 设备已有活动执行进程。
device_process_conflict.en-US: The device already has an active execution process.

device_registration_changed.zh-CN: 设备登记已变化，请重新证明。
device_registration_changed.en-US: The device registration has changed. Verify the device again.

device_registration_conflict.zh-CN: 设备公钥或授权绑定冲突。
device_registration_conflict.en-US: The device public key or authorization binding conflicts with its registration.

device_request_resolved.zh-CN: 设备申请已完成或已过期。
device_request_resolved.en-US: The device request has already been resolved or expired.

email_code_sent.zh-CN: 如果该邮箱符合条件，验证码将发送至邮箱。
email_code_sent.en-US: If this email address is eligible, a verification code will be sent to it.

email_failed.zh-CN: 邮件发送失败，请稍后重试或联系管理员。
email_failed.en-US: The email could not be sent. Try again later or contact your administrator.

email_unavailable.en-US: The email service has not been configured.

endpoint_limit_exceeded.en-US: The endpoint limit has been reached.

expired_token.zh-CN: 授权码已过期，请重新发起授权。
expired_token.en-US: The authorization code has expired. Please start authorization again.

image_concurrency_limit.zh-CN: 生图任务繁忙，请稍后重试。
image_concurrency_limit.en-US: Image generation is busy. Please try again later.

image_job_not_unknown.zh-CN: 生图任务状态已变化，请重新核查。
image_job_not_unknown.en-US: The image task state has changed. Please review it again.

image_too_large.zh-CN: 图片大小不能超过 5 MB。
image_too_large.en-US: The image must not exceed 5 MB.

import_failed.zh-CN: 所选分区导入失败，请检查分区结果。
import_failed.en-US: A selected section could not be imported. Check the section results.

import_conflict.zh-CN: 导入状态冲突，请重新预览后重试。
import_conflict.en-US: The import state conflicts with the request. Preview it again before retrying.

invalid_client.zh-CN: 客户端信息无效或不受支持。
invalid_client.en-US: The client information is invalid or unsupported.

invalid_credentials.en-US: The account or credentials are invalid.

invalid_csrf.zh-CN: 操作已失效，请刷新页面后重试。
invalid_csrf.en-US: This operation has expired. Refresh the page and try again.

invalid_device_proof.en-US: The device identity proof is invalid.

invalid_grant.zh-CN: 授权凭据无效或已过期。
invalid_grant.en-US: The authorization grant is invalid or has expired.

invalid_image.en-US: The image content or format is invalid.

invalid_key.zh-CN: 调用密钥无效或权限不足。
invalid_key.en-US: The invocation key is invalid or has insufficient permissions.

invalid_origin.en-US: The request origin is not allowed.

invalid_scope.zh-CN: 请求的权限无效或未被批准。
invalid_scope.en-US: The requested scopes are invalid or have not been approved.

invalid_session.zh-CN: 会话无效或不属于当前用户。
invalid_session.en-US: The session is invalid or does not belong to the current user.

invalid_target.en-US: The requested audience is not supported.

invalid_transaction_state.zh-CN: 交易当前状态不允许执行此操作。
invalid_transaction_state.en-US: The current transaction state does not allow this operation.

local_billing_required.zh-CN: 仅直接计费模式支持立即重置额度。
local_billing_required.en-US: Quotas can only be reset immediately in direct billing mode.

mcp_internal_error.en-US: The MCP request could not be processed.

member_writer_unavailable.en-US: User account write operations are unavailable.

model_error.zh-CN: 模型操作失败，请检查模型配置。
model_error.en-US: The model operation failed. Please check the model configuration.

model_limits_required.zh-CN: 计费模型需要有效的上下文与最大输出限制。
model_limits_required.en-US: Billed models require valid context and maximum output limits.

model_protocol_mismatch.zh-CN: 模型协议与请求端点不匹配。
model_protocol_mismatch.en-US: The model protocol does not match the requested endpoint.

not_acceptable.zh-CN: 客户端不接受代理支持的响应编码。
not_acceptable.en-US: The client does not accept any response encoding supported by the proxy.

not_host.zh-CN: 请求机器与会话宿主不一致。
not_host.en-US: The requesting machine does not match the session host.

pairing_already_joined.en-US: This pairing has already been used.

pairing_not_found.en-US: The pairing does not exist or has expired.

pairing_resolved.zh-CN: 配对已处理或尚未加入。
pairing_resolved.en-US: The pairing has already been resolved or has not been joined.

password_changed.zh-CN: 密码已发生变化，请重新输入当前密码。
password_changed.en-US: The password has changed. Enter the current password again.

password_not_set.zh-CN: 账号尚未设置密码，请通过登录页的找回密码设置。
password_not_set.en-US: This account has no password. Use password recovery on the sign-in page to set one.

provider_not_found.en-US: The sign-in provider was not found.

provider_unavailable.en-US: The sign-in provider is temporarily unavailable.

relay_overloaded.en-US: The relay resource limit has been reached.

report_conflict.zh-CN: 上报内容与已接收记录冲突。
report_conflict.en-US: The report conflicts with an already accepted record.

request_not_found.en-US: The authorization request was not found.

request_required.en-US: A client authorization request is required.

request_unavailable.zh-CN: 授权申请无效或已过期。
request_unavailable.en-US: The authorization request is invalid or has expired.

reset_failed.zh-CN: 密码重置失败，请重新获取验证码。
reset_failed.en-US: The password could not be reset. Request a new verification code.

resource_not_found.zh-CN: 资源不存在或不可下载。
resource_not_found.en-US: The resource does not exist or cannot be downloaded.

resource_version_mismatch.zh-CN: 资源摘要与所选快照不匹配。
resource_version_mismatch.en-US: The resource checksum does not match the selected snapshot.

server_error.zh-CN: 服务内部错误，请稍后重试。
server_error.en-US: An internal server error occurred. Please try again later.

session_host_conflict.zh-CN: 请求机器与认证宿主不一致。
session_host_conflict.en-US: The requesting machine does not match the authenticated host.

session_not_registered.zh-CN: 会话尚未注册或已清除。
session_not_registered.en-US: The session has not been registered or has been removed.

session_owned_by_other.en-US: The session belongs to another user.

session_purged.en-US: The session statistics have been purged.

settings_unavailable.en-US: The authentication settings are temporarily unavailable.

slow_down.zh-CN: 轮询过于频繁，请降低频率。
slow_down.en-US: Polling too frequently. Please reduce the polling rate.

snapshot_not_found.zh-CN: 快照不存在或尚未导入。
snapshot_not_found.en-US: The snapshot was not found or has not been imported.

state_conflict.zh-CN: 状态序号与状态内容冲突。
state_conflict.en-US: The state sequence conflicts with the state contents.

storage_unavailable.en-US: The storage service is temporarily unavailable.

temporarily_unavailable.zh-CN: 服务暂不可用，请稍后重试。
temporarily_unavailable.en-US: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

terminal_limit_reached.zh-CN: 终端或数据流名额已满。
terminal_limit_reached.en-US: The terminal or data stream limit has been reached.

time_order.en-US: The timestamps are not in a valid chronological order.

transaction_not_refundable.zh-CN: 仅已结算的非零本地扣款可退款。
transaction_not_refundable.en-US: Only settled, nonzero local charges can be refunded.

transaction_not_retryable.zh-CN: 只有已确定用量的待结算交易可重试。
transaction_not_retryable.en-US: Only pending transactions with confirmed usage can be retried. Review unknown outcomes first.

transaction_not_unknown.zh-CN: 只有结果未知的交易可以核查处理。
transaction_not_unknown.en-US: Only transactions with an unknown outcome can be reviewed.

unavailable.zh-CN: 服务或签发配置暂不可用。
unavailable.en-US: The service or token issuing configuration is unavailable.

unchanged_password.zh-CN: 新密码不能与当前密码相同。
unchanged_password.en-US: The new password must differ from the current password.

unknown_resources_snapshot.zh-CN: 资源快照不存在或摘要不匹配。
unknown_resources_snapshot.en-US: The resource snapshot is missing or its checksum does not match.

unsupported_design_section.en-US: This design section version is not supported.

unsupported_grant_type.en-US: The requested grant type is not supported.

unsupported_protocol.en-US: The protocol version is not supported.

unsupported_response_type.en-US: Only the authorization code response type is supported.

user_exists.en-US: An account with this email address already exists.

video_input_too_large.zh-CN: 视频参考图超过大小限制。
video_input_too_large.en-US: The video reference image exceeds the size limit.

video_unavailable.en-US: The video service is not ready.

wallet_configuration_changed.zh-CN: 原交易的钱包配置不可用。
wallet_configuration_changed.en-US: The wallet configuration for the original transaction is unavailable.

wallet_identity_changed.zh-CN: 钱包归属已改变，需核查原交易。
wallet_identity_changed.en-US: The wallet owner has changed. Review the original transaction.

wallet_not_configured.zh-CN: 请配置有效的百智云应用和证书。
wallet_not_configured.en-US: Configure a valid Baizhiyun application and certificates in billing settings first.

wallet_refund_required.zh-CN: 远程退款需经百智云退款或对账渠道处理。
wallet_refund_required.en-US: Remote refunds must be handled through Baizhiyun refund or reconciliation channels.

wallet_review_required.zh-CN: 需先通过百智云核实预扣状态。
wallet_review_required.en-US: Verify the reservation status with Baizhiyun before releasing it locally.

wallet_transactions_pending.zh-CN: 存在未完成的远程交易，请处理后再切换计费应用。
wallet_transactions_pending.en-US: Resolve pending remote transactions before changing the service URL or application ID. Certificates can be updated for the same application.

wallet_unavailable.zh-CN: 未配置百智云计费连接。
wallet_unavailable.en-US: The Baizhiyun billing connection is not configured.

wallet_user_invalid.en-US: The Baizhiyun user identity could not be verified.

wallet_user_unbound.zh-CN: 请通过百智云登录并绑定扣费账户。
wallet_user_unbound.en-US: Sign in through Baizhiyun and bind the billing account if multiple identities are present.

seats_exceeded.zh-CN: 席位不足，请联系管理员导入有效 License 或增加授权席位。
seats_exceeded.en-US: There are not enough licensed seats. Ask your administrator to import a valid license or add seats.

seats_unavailable.zh-CN: 席位授权不可用，请联系管理员导入有效 License。
seats_unavailable.en-US: Seat licensing is unavailable. Ask your administrator to import a valid license.

http_406.zh-CN: 客户端不接受可用的响应格式。
http_406.en-US: No acceptable response format is available.

http_413.zh-CN: 请求内容超过大小限制。
http_413.en-US: The request exceeds the size limit.

http_415.zh-CN: 请求的内容类型不受支持。
http_415.en-US: The request content type is not supported.

http_429.zh-CN: 请求过于频繁，请稍后重试。
http_429.en-US: Too many requests. Please try again later.

upstream_connection_failed.zh-CN: 连接上游模型失败，请检查模型配置，或重试
upstream_connection_failed.en-US: Could not connect to the upstream model. Check the model configuration or try again.
